lede: The biggest item this week is Mountain Village Town Council taking up first reading of an ordinance that would move Housing Authority fees out of the municipal code into an annually updated fee schedule — a structural shift in how affordable housing costs get set that deserves close attention. San Miguel County's Housing Code SSR working group also convenes for its eighth session, drilling into Land Use Code provisions that slow workforce housing in unincorporated areas. Meanwhile, HARC has a notable work session on a potential demolition and new construction at Rebekah Hall, the Town-owned building at 113 W Columbia, and the BOCC takes up a land-use MOU tied to a 1999 view plain settlement.
